acs.text: WHEN POST /api/test/persona is called with a known persona, the environment name matches ^test(-|$) and the x-qa- persona-secret header equals QA_PERSONA_SECRET THE SYSTEM SHALL return that persona's bearer token and a one-time harness sign-in URL, and GET /api/v1/me with the token SHALL return the persona's id

acs.text: WHEN the environment name does not match the test pattern, or the secret header is missing or wrong, or QA_PERSONA_SECRET is unset THE SYSTEM SHALL return 403 and create no session
scenarios: AC-002 return 403 and create no session

acs.text: WHEN the production build is inspected THE SYSTEM SHALL contain no route handler that issues persona sessions, proven by a test that enumerates the production routes
scenarios: AC-003 contain no route handler that issues persona sessions, proven by a test that enumerates th

acs.text: WHEN npm run qa:seed runs twice for the same scenario THE SYSTEM SHALL create nothing the second time
scenarios: AC-004 create nothing the second time

acs.text: WHEN npm run qa:reset runs THE SYSTEM SHALL leave zero rows in every table of the schema, checked against the schema itself
